plan.selection: Exactly once on discovery: >=500 decisive, >=100 each BTC/ETH, >=58% point win, positive net; maximum Bonferroni-Wilson lower over16 augmented candidates, lexical tie. Controls never selected.
plan.later_gates: Validation>=400 and confirmation>=100, each>=58% and positive; continuous weekly win lower>1/1.85 and weekly net lower>0; all fits converged and training labels strictly settled.
plan.execution_gates: 2bp adverse-entry net positive and minimum settled bankroll>=5 in validation,confirmation,continuous later periods.
plan.incremental_gate: Selected-minus-exact-control continuous weekly net lower95>0 is a separate incremental-evidence flag.
plan.cache_policy: Numeric completed stage7 predictions only; verify exact source/identity/paired row-label proof/SHA contracts. No training, raw feature reload, network or cache writes.
plan.later_read_barrier: Stage7 complete result must exist and validate frozen source/plan before any later cache is evaluated.
plan.evaluator_source_policy: Freeze evaluator implementation hash in a separate implementation record before opening discovery cache; never overwrite this plan.

implementation.cache_policy: read-only validated numeric arrays; no fit path or fallback

limitations: This is another related exploratory search over reused history, not a fresh holdout.
The catalog reuses eight .56/.60 augmented configurations and adds eight .64/.68 configurations; all sixteen enter discovery correction.
Only the discovery winner is selected; all sixteen augmented and sixteen exact controls are disclosed without later replacement.
Bonferroni correction for this catalog does not remove serial dependence or accumulated bias from earlier research rounds.
Record+10 minute availability remains an explicit assumption; original API timing and archive revisions are not proven.
Raw scores are not calibrated win probabilities. A higher threshold can reduce trade count without improving true future performance.
No models were fitted and no original feature arrays were loaded. Only verified completed paired numeric predictions were reused.
Index-minute prices proxy contract quotes; 2bp stress and known-calendar exclusions do not capture every execution risk.
No live model, alert, server, GitHub remote or account was changed.
